decisions.reason: Although it was launched with its own page, the product was no longer visibly maintained on the website after 2019 and, being less central to the firm's stated expansion path than its core filtration and conveying lines, management would be less inclined to keep committing resources to it by 2022.

As a coolant filtration product that builds directly on the firm's established fluid-handling offer, it fits existing engineering, modular platforms and one-stop system logic, so management would be inclined to continue it despite limited later visibility.

Because the gravity band coolant filter is close to the firm's core business and can be justified as part of the broad modular range promised to customers, management would likely persist with it rather than reverse course quickly.
